headline: Asian Sovereign Debt Outperforms as Oil and US Treasury Yields Decline
summary: Asian government bonds posted strong weekly performance led by Indian sovereign debt, with India's benchmark 2036 bond yield falling about 22 basis points for the week to 7.1973%.
why: Asian government bond yields set long-term corporate borrowing costs across emerging market economies.

impacts.name: India 10-Year Bond Yield
impacts.why: Lower international crude oil prices and falling US yields increased demand for Asian sovereign debt.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Softening US Treasury yields and declining oil prices boosted foreign investor appetite for fixed-income paper.
